intent: Each jump has a 1-in-30 chance to set off a short-lived explosion where the jumper took off. Anyone caught in its small radius (jumper included) is blasted away and slammed downward, losing height; a visible fireball and shake make it readable.
accept: Some jumps (roughly 1 in 30) produce a visible explosion at the take-off point; most do not
A player inside the blast radius is thrown sideways and downward, and a player outside is unaffected
The explosion looks the same regardless of who jumped
A test forces the chance roll and checks the blast hits only players in range
